name: right-certificate
title: Certificate of exclusive right of burial
for_each: select r.id, h.name || ' ' || rl.plot as label from rights r join holders h on h.id = r.holder_id join right_lapses rl on rl.right_id = r.id order by rl.plot

sections.title: The right
sections.note: Sold under section 10(1) of the Burial and Cremation Act 1964. No burial may take place in this plot without the holder's consent (s 10(2)).
sections.sql: select rl.plot, rl.holder, coalesce(r.certificate_no, '') as certificate, r.purchased_on, coalesce(r.term_years::text, 'In perpetuity') as term from rights r join right_lapses rl on rl.right_id = r.id where r.id = $1

sections.title: Interments in this plot
sections.sql: select coalesce(i.register_no::text, '') as register_no, d.name, d.date_of_death, i.completed_on from rights r join interments i on i.plot_id = r.plot_id join deceased d on d.id = i.deceased_id where r.id = $1 and i.status = 'completed' order by i.completed_on

sections.title: When the right ends
sections.note: Under section 10(4) the right lapses if 60 years pass without a burial in the plot.
sections.sql: select rl.last_burial_on, rl.lapses_on, rl.term_ends_on from right_lapses rl where rl.right_id = $1

name: burial-register
title: Register of burials
for_each: select id, name from cemeteries order by name

sections.title: Burials
sections.note: Kept under section 50 of the Burial and Cremation Act 1964: where each body is buried and a description of every grave, indexed by name. Open for inspection.
sections.sql: select coalesce(r.register_no::text, '') as no, r.deceased, r.date_of_birth, r.date_of_death, r.age_years as age, r.section, r.row_label as row, r.number as plot, r.kind, r.completed_on, case when r.status = 'removed' then 'Removed under licence' else '' end as note from register r join cemeteries c on c.name = r.cemetery where c.id = $1 order by r.deceased, r.completed_on

name: director-statement
title: Account statement
for_each: select id, name from funeral_directors order by name

sections.title: Charges
sections.sql: select raised_on, due_on, description, amount_cents, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from charges where funeral_director_id = $1 order by raised_on, created_at

sections.title: Payments received
sections.sql: select received_on, coalesce(reference, '') as reference, amount_cents, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from payments where funeral_director_id = $1 order by received_on

sections.title: Balance
sections.note: Charges due to today less payments received.
sections.sql: select charged_cents, due_cents, paid_cents, overdue_cents, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from accounts where account_id = $1
